subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

He is __almost quiet__ well.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"quiet"** means making little or no noise; being calm and silent. (शांत)

 
 
• **Example: **The library is a quiet place for reading and studying.
 
 
 
• **"Quite" **is an adverb that means completely or to a certain degree; it is used for emphasis. (काफी)
 
 
• **Example: **She was quite happy with the results of her exam.
 
 
 
• Hence, in the sentence "He is almost quiet well," the correct word to use is **'quite'** to indicate the degree of wellness.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: almost quietly** (लगभग चुपचाप): This phrase is incorrect in the given context.

 
 
• **Example:** He almost quietly left the room without anyone noticing.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: very quite** (बहुत शांत): This phrase is grammatically incorrect as "quite" and "very" should not be used together in this context.
 
 
• **Example: **The phrase "very quite" is not grammatically correct.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: quiet** (शांत): This word means "silent" and does not fit the context of the sentence properly.
 
 
• **Example:** The room was very quiet after everyone left.
 
 

 

40:Tcd3,

The correct answer is: Option 3
